newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen slow in consolidation phase.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen slow in consolidation phase.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be slow in early trade on Friday as the market is still in a consolidation phase, but speculation in secondary stocks is likely to continue, brokers said.
Brokers said they expected slow trading as many investors are likely to adopt a wait-and-see attitude after a sharp correction in the index on Thursday.

"The potential for a technical rebound in the index is still on, because yesterday's correction was due to technical reasons, not to fundamental reasons," a senior broker with PT Pentasena Securities said.
He predicted local investors will continue to focus on medium and small-capitalised stocks.
Medium-capitalised plastic and packaging sheets maker PT Dynaplast is expected to reap market attention on a news report that it plans to split its stock and issue bonus shares, brokers said.
On Thursday, the Jakarta Composite Index was down 8.99 points, or 1.22 percent, to close at 729.15 points after touching an intra-day low of 724.25 points during the day.
